title: BDTP. Marketing Channels vs Programs with Asia Orangio
html: <iframe src="https://player.simplecast.com/e96ea7f2-f7bc-4362-a3f4-368212abfaf1" height="200" width="100%" title="BDTP. Marketing Channels vs Programs with Asia Orangio" frameborder="0" scrolling="no"></iframe>
description: Why should your marketing evolve into programs? In this episode, we talk to Asia Orangio, founder and CEO of DemandMaven. You'll learn about the five growth levers you can pull, why you might be doing OKRs wrong, how to know which marketing programs to double down on, and more.
